nodes.description: address public bridge; trusted relayer/bridge address that is the only caller allowed by the isBridge modifier
CountersUpgradeable.Counter private _IssueCtr; monotonic proposal id counter
mapping(uint256 => issueStruct) private issueMap; stores status, startBlock, endBlock, quorum, maxVotes and resultOption of each proposal
mapping(uint256 => mapping(address => hasVotedStruct)) private hasVoted; per-proposal voter record used for double-vote protection
mapping(uint256 => mapping(uint8 => uint256)) private voteWeight; accumulated weight per proposal option
external initialize() with initializer modifier; entry point of the UUPS proxy initialization
internal _authorizeUpgrade(address) override restricted with onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE); gate for UUPS upgrades
setBridge(address) public onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE); writes the privileged bridge address
mint(address) public isBridge; mints 1 ether of the non-transferable voting token to an account
burn(address) public isBridge; burns 1 ether of the voting token from an account
createProposal(uint256 endBlock, uint64 quorum) public isBridge isValidquorum; creates a new Active proposal
vote(uint256 issueId, uint8 option, address relayer) public with isBridge/isvalidIssue/isNotVoted/isValidOption/isNotEnded/isValidbalance; records a vote and tallies weight
setStatus(uint256 issueId) public isVotingEnded isBridge; finalizes a proposal as Passed or Cancelled
internal _setStatus(uint256 issueId, uint8 option, ProposalStatus status); writes resultOption/status and emits OnStatusChange
executeProposal(uint256 issueId) public isPassed isBridge; marks a passed proposal as Executed
internal overridden _transfer(address,address,uint256) that unconditionally reverts, making the token non-transferable
fetchIsExpired(uint256) public view; returns block.number >= issueMap[_issue].endBlock
fetchCtr() public view; returns _IssueCtr.current()
ballotOf(uint256,address) public view; returns the option a voter chose
Voted(uint256,address) public view; returns whether an address has voted
GetProposalHash(uint8,uint64,bytes32) public pure; keccak256(abi.encodePacked(chainID,depositNonce,dataHash))
weightOf(address) public view; returns balanceOf(addr)
getStatus(uint256) public view; returns issueMap[issueId].status
weightedVoteCountsOf(uint256,uint8) public view; returns voteWeight[issueId][option]
fetchIssueMap(uint256) public view; returns the whole issueStruct
internal __VoterUpgradeable_init() initializer; wires AccessControl, ERC20 and admin role setup
UUPS upgrade path performs delegatecall/upgradeToAndCallSecure to an arbitrary newImplementation supplied by the caller
_setupRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, _msgSender()) bypasses the AccessControl admin checks and grants admin to the initializer caller
percentage computation (yes * 10000) / totalSupply(); integer division/truncation and potential division-by-zero when supply is zero
overridden _transfer always reverts, breaking any ERC20 transfer/transferFrom integration
msg.sender / _msgSender(); used in isBridge comparisons and in onlyRole checks
block.number (block/timestamp dependency) used for proposal startBlock, isNotEnded, isVotingEnded and fetchIsExpired
internal overridden _beforeTokenTransfer hook called on mint/burn/transfer
endBlock parameter of createProposal
quorum parameter of createProposal validated by isValidquorum
issueId parameter used as mapping key in vote/setStatus/executeProposal and view getters
option parameter of vote validated by isValidOption
relayer address parameter of vote whose balance weight is counted
account parameter of mint and burn
_b parameter of setBridge that becomes the new bridge address
newImplementation parameter passed to _authorizeUpgrade and to the UUPS upgrade delegatecall
addr parameter of ballotOf/Voted/weightOf
local uint256 balance = balanceOf(relayer) inside vote
local uint256 yesPercent percentage computed in vote and setStatus
local uint256 ctr = _IssueCtr.current() inside createProposal

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared to the stored bridge address by the isBridge modifier before vote() executes
isBridge requires msg.sender == bridge for createProposal
isBridge gates mint() on msg.sender being the bridge
isBridge gates burn() on msg.sender being the bridge
isBridge gates executeProposal() on msg.sender being the bridge
isBridge gates setStatus() on msg.sender being the bridge
onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) checks _msgSender() before setBridge changes the privileged bridge
_authorizeUpgrade is protected by onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) evaluated on _msgSender()
_setupRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, _msgSender()) grants the admin role to the initialization caller without any check
the bridge state variable is read inside the isBridge modifier guarding vote()
setBridge writes the validated _b value into the bridge state variable
issueMap is read (quorum, endBlock, status) and written (maxVotes) inside vote()
voteWeight[issueId][option] is increased by the voter balance in vote()
hasVoted[issueId][relayer] is read by isNotVoted and then written after the vote
_IssueCtr is incremented and read to derive the new proposal id
createProposal assigns a fresh issueStruct into issueMap[ctr]
fetchCtr returns _IssueCtr.current()
setStatus reads voteWeight[issueId][1] to compute the yes percentage
setStatus reads issueMap[issueId].quorum and its outcome is written back by _setStatus
executeProposal writes ProposalStatus.Executed into issueMap[issueId].status
block.number is stored as startBlock, making proposal timing dependent on block production
the isNotEnded modifier compares block.number with issueMap[issueId].endBlock before voting
the isVotingEnded modifier requires block.number >= endBlock before status can be finalized
fetchIsExpired returns block.number >= issueMap[_issue].endBlock
_setStatus is invoked after voteWeight has been updated by the caller
_setStatus writes resultOption and status back into issueMap[issueId]
weightedVoteCountsOf exposes voteWeight[issueId][option]
ballotOf returns hasVoted[issueId][addr].option
Voted returns hasVoted[issueId][addr].voted
getStatus returns issueMap[issueId].status
fetchIssueMap returns the full issueMap[_issue] struct
fetchIsExpired reads issueMap[_issue].endBlock
vote() computes yesPercent = (yes * 10000) / totalSupply(), an unchecked-style integer division that truncates and divides by supply
setStatus() performs the same (yes * 10000) / totalSupply() integer division for the quorum comparison
the local balance read from balanceOf(relayer) feeds the vote-weight arithmetic and the quorum percentage
endBlock argument is stored in the new issueStruct by createProposal
quorum argument is validated by isValidquorum and stored in the new issueStruct
issueId is used to index issueMap, hasVoted and voteWeight inside vote()
option is validated by isValidOption and stored in hasVoted/voteWeight during vote()
relayer address determines whose balance is used as voting weight in vote()
account is the recipient of 1 ether minted by mint()
account is the target of the 1 ether burn in burn()
validated _b is assigned to the bridge state variable, transferring bridge-only privileges
newImplementation is the target of the delegatecall performed by the UUPS upgrade path
initialize() calls __VoterUpgradeable_init()
__VoterUpgradeable_init calls _setupRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, _msgSender()) which grants the highest privilege unchecked
vote() calls _setStatus(issueId, 1, ProposalStatus.Passed) when yesPercent exceeds quorum
setStatus() delegates the state transition to _setStatus for Passed or Cancelled outcomes
_authorizeUpgrade is the access-control gate that must pass before the upgrade delegatecall is executed
the overridden _transfer unconditionally reverts, disabling all ERC20 transfers
the delegatecall to a caller-supplied newImplementation executes arbitrary code that can re-enter the contract (e.g. re-invoke _authorizeUpgrade/initialize paths) before storage is finalized
mint calls the _beforeTokenTransfer hook, which can be overridden by derived contracts
burn calls the _beforeTokenTransfer hook
the overridden _transfer invokes super._beforeTokenTransfer before reverting
